title: I Love Kizomba Sensual Festival Semba Festival “A Nossa Moda” 1st Edition
description:
𝗜𝗟𝗞𝗦𝗙 𝗦𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗮 𝗙𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗮𝗹 𝗥𝗼𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗱𝗮𝗺 “𝗔 𝗡𝗼𝘀𝘀𝗮 𝗠𝗼𝗱𝗮” – 1st Edition
Welcome to the next ILKSF festival and this one will be different.
In our beloved country, The Netherlands, we feel that something is missing: 𝗮 𝗳𝘂𝗹𝗹 𝘄𝗲𝗲𝗸𝗲𝗻𝗱 𝗱𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗦𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗮, 𝗰𝘂𝗹𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗔𝗻𝗴𝗼𝗹𝗮𝗻 𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗴𝘆. That is exactly what we want to bring to you.
This festival will take place in Rotterdam, the mecca of Kizomba in The Netherlands, a city full of passion, culture, and dance.
𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁:
• 3 days of pure Angolan energy
• International & national artists
• Parties, socials & workshops
• Delicious food
• Delicious cocktails
• Angolan seminar about music & dance
• Semba Dance Battle
Get ready to experience Semba “𝗔 𝗡𝗼𝘀𝘀𝗮 𝗠𝗼𝗱𝗮” — our way.
